newsitem.title: USA: CML's NordicTrack could aid Q2 net.
newsitem.headline: CML's NordicTrack could aid Q2 net.

text.p: CML Group Inc said on Tuesday that its NordicTrack home fitness products unit could bring the company to profitability in its peak-selling second quarter, compared with a loss of $0.29 a share in the year ago period.

NordicTrack recently introduced three cross-country skier products, and a new strength-training machine for its second quarter, the company said. Upcoming products include a leg-toning machine and a motorized treadmill, the company said.

CML chairman and chief executive officer Charles Leighton said in a statement, "If the new NordicTrack fitness products are favorably received by consumers and Smith & Hawken has a good holiday season, we would expect to see a profitable second fiscal quarter."
At the end of the first quarter, the company had approximately $42 million in cash and no bank debt outstanding, CML said.
